text.p: Here are the highlights from Swiss newspapers on Monday:

- Guido Egli, chairman of the board of food and beverage group Hero Schweiz, announced his resignation effective December 31. - Swiss President Jean Pascal Delamuraz said in a newspaper interview that Switzerland's economic situation is likely to continue to worsen and that unemployment could climb to over five percent in 1997. He added that a "catastrophe programme" is ready to be implemented if necessary.
- Traffic in Switzerland increased by 10 percent from 1990 to 1995.
- A recent survey found that some 70 percent of Swiss expect unemployment to rise in 1997. Nearly 75 percent predict an increase in social problems.
- The government of the Canton of Zurich rejected Zurich Kantonalbank's application to modify its statutes in order to privatise.
